articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.description: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation data
articles.description: The legal action against Kalshi focused on trademark infringement and injury to its reputation in addition to citing state authorities comparing the company’s contracts to gambling.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.description: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

articles.title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
articles.description: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops to one-week low as retail buys gold at highest prices since June
articles.description: Bitcoin price action sank to one-week lows ahead of US CPI data, while retail investors piled into gold ETFs and XAU/USD hit its highest levels in nine weeks.

articles.title: ADI Chain, Shipfinex partner to tokenize $500M vessel pipeline
articles.description: Shipfinex plans to bring 35 vessels onchain through ADI Chain as tokenization expands into the multitrillion-dollar maritime industry.

articles.title: SharpLink reports $394M in Q2 net loss fueled by ETH decline
articles.description: SharpLink reported a net loss of $394 million in the second quarter of 2026, largely driven by Ether’s 23% decline during the quarter.

articles.title: EToro to buy TradeZero as Q2 crypto revenue falls 30%
articles.description: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.

articles.title: Russia proposes exchange trading of Bitcoin, Ether and Tether’s USDT
articles.description: Russia’s central bank proposed allowing Bitcoin, Ether and USDT to trade on regulated exchanges, following a law signed by President Vladimir Putin last week.

articles.title: Bitcoin sell pressure ‘closer to exhaustion’ after $4B USDT market-cap drop: CryptoQuant
articles.description: Bitcoin analysis suggested that sell pressure would not increase given the historically large contraction in USDT market cap over a 60-day period.

articles.title: Coldcard hack losses: How investigators trace stolen Bitcoin
articles.description: The Coldcard hack has no definitive loss figure yet as investigators rely on victim reports and onchain analysis that produce varying estimates.

articles.title: Keel shuts US Bitcoin mining operations as Q2 revenue falls 50%
articles.description: Keel completed the shutdown of its US Bitcoin mining operations as it pivots toward AI and high-performance computing infrastructure

articles.title: Anthropic strikes $9B compute deal with Bitcoin miner Riot: Report
articles.description: Anthropic reportedly struck a $9 billion deal with Riot for 191 megawatts of capacity from the Bitcoin miner’s Rockdale campus in Texas.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: South Korea drops Travel Rule threshold for crypto transfers
articles.description: South Korea will remove its 1 million won Travel Rule threshold and apply information-sharing requirements to all transfers between registered crypto service providers.

articles.title: Payments platform Decta explores stablecoin-enabled treasury settlement
articles.description: Decta will use USDC through OpenPayd’s infrastructure for international treasury settlement, seeking faster transfers and more efficient liquidity management.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr removed as Bitcoin Improvement Proposal editor
articles.description: Luke Dashjr lost his BIP editor privileges after developers raised concerns over his role in BIP 110 and its stalled minority fork.

articles.title: White House vows to get CLARITY across ‘finish line’ in September
articles.description: Patrick Witt says the Trump administration will keep negotiating with Democrats as the Senate prepares for a September CLARITY vote.

articles.title: Trump Media to revamp crypto treasury strategy after $238M Q2 loss
articles.description: Trump Media says it will take a more disciplined approach to its crypto treasury while directing more resources toward its core media business.

articles.title: Thailand’s 0% crypto tax. Bitcoin Red Team forced to use Chinese AI: Asia Express
articles.description: The Bitcoin Red Team has been forced to rely on open source Chinese AI, after OpenAI restricted access. Thailand sets crypto tax to 0% in bid to become crypto hub.

articles.title: Judge stays CFTC’s case against US soldier over prediction market bets
articles.description: A New York judge granted a motion filed by US prosecutors in July to stay the CFTC’s civil case against Gannon Ken Van Dyke over making more than $400,000 on prediction markets.

articles.title: Tron USDT supply hits $87.9B as transfers reach $2.1T in Q2: Messari
articles.description: Messari reported that Tron recorded all-time highs in stablecoin supply and network activity during the second quarter, while DeFi and decentralized exchange activity declined.

articles.title: UK money laundering suspect bought $100M in Trump crypto business: NYT
articles.description: An individual behind the Aqua 1 entity that purchased $100 million worth of World Liberty Financial tokens in 2025 is reportedly a businessman with ties to the UK and UAE.

articles.title: Coinsbuy offers $100K reward after Sunday security breach
articles.description: Coinsbuy said it covered all affected client funds after unauthorized withdrawals, while an onchain investigator estimated more than $7.9 million was stolen.

articles.title: ‘Disappointing’: Crypto advocates react to delay in CLARITY vote
articles.description: Following a procedural delay in the US Senate, lawmakers are expected to address a major crypto market structure bill after they return from a month-long recess, which met with industry criticism.

articles.title: Bitcoin price slip wipes weekend gains as oil surge hits 5% on Hormuz disappointment
articles.description: Bitcoin wobbled with US stocks as Iran deflated hopes on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz oil route, while analysis praised “exceptionally strong” institutional BTC inflows.

articles.title: BlackRock launches 2 Canada ETFs, with one allocating 3% to Bitcoin
articles.description: BlackRock Canada’s new IBQT fund combines global equity exposure with a 3% Bitcoin allocation through the firm’s Canadian iShares Bitcoin ETF.

articles.title: Bitdeer increased Bitcoin mining output by nearly fivefold in Q2
articles.description: Bitdeer mined 2,694 BTC in Q2, but ended the quarter holding just 150 BTC after liquidating its treasury earlier this year.

articles.title: Strategy turns 1,690 BTC into $108.6M STRC buyback
articles.description: Strategy sold 1,690 Bitcoin to repurchase STRC shares as its US dollar reserve rose to $4.65 billion and its Bitcoin holdings fell to 840,447 BTC.

articles.title: Tokenized RWA surge to $4T may push LINK to $200 by end-2030: Standard Chartered
articles.description: The LINK token may see a 25-fold increase to $200 by the end of 2030, as the growing real world asset market increases demand for the industry’s largest oracle services provider, according to Standard Chartered.
